entities.summary: Your Party is a socialist political party in the United Kingdom announced in July 2025 by Jeremy Corbyn and Zarah Sultana. It was registered with the Electoral Commission on 30 September 2025. The party is led by its Central Executive Committee, under a system of collective leadership. Corbyn has served as the party's parliamentary leader since March 2026.
